findings.title: Returning to an already delivered mode suppresses the current persona
findings.evidence_level: focused isolated runtime probe + implementation read
findings.description: Delivery is keyed by session, mode and compaction generation. In one session/generation, arbiter -> dangerous -> arbiter leaves the original arbiter tuple marked, so the final arbiter effective mode emits no arbiter persona after dangerous was injected.
findings.observed: Actual shared mode writes/audits and actual persona files: initial arbiter output10990 characters; dangerous7908; return to arbiter0. This does not disable deterministic tool/Git guards.
findings.recommendation: Bind delivery to current successful mode transition epoch or last delivered mode/generation, with monotonic session identity; preserve repeated-event idempotency and independent safety injection.

findings.title: Mode flip failure reports no change after raw state has already changed
findings.evidence_level: isolated injected append failure + implementation read
findings.description: flip writes raw mode before audit settlement. An audit append failure returns FLIP_FAILED; prompt text calls it a marker write error and says the session remains in its current mode. The raw mode can already be ops while effective mode falls back to arbiter because it is not ledger-backed.
findings.observed: With _append_override_line forced false: result failed, raw_mode ops, effective_mode arbiter, user_message says marker write error and remains in current mode. Owed audit recovery is implemented; failure is not evidence of total rollback.
findings.recommendation: Return typed outcome carrying requested/raw/effective modes, marker commit and audit debt/retry state. Report partial completion honestly; preserve existing recovery and gate fail direction.

findings.title: Pi doctor rejects the actual scoped package identity
findings.evidence_level: actual checkout payload checked through check_payload
findings.description: doctor.check_payload requires package.name == ca-pi; current plugins/ca-pi/package.json and PiHost identify @arbiterforge/ca-pi. It produces a reinstall failure for this otherwise present payload.
findings.observed: check_payload(PiHost) on this checkout reports payload version0.27.5 OK, invalid ca-pi discovery contract FAIL, and bridge/support scripts OK.
findings.recommendation: Use the actual canonical host/package identity shared with manifest generation and host resolver; retain exact extension/skill discovery validation.

findings.title: Qualified npm workspace binding can exceed native completion consumer limit
findings.classification: confirmed producer reachability; cross-layer consumer mismatch validated by native agent
findings.evidence_level: actual Python producer probe; Go consumer static read by native_states
findings.description: The Python producer permits up to32 workspace manifests plus base launch files. Native observation schema permits37, qualified runner permits32 workspace manifests, but completionWorkspacesOnce rejects more than32 launch_files. A qualified operation can reach publication with a producer-valid binding the consumer refuses.
findings.observed: Using real npm resolution and temp Git project, without running test commands:30 workspaces ->32 launch files;31->33;32->34 on POSIX. Windows additional launch roles imply up to37 from source, not runtime-probed here.
cross_agent_sources: native_states: observation/contract.go commandBindingSchema; evidence/runner_contract.go validateQualifiedBinding; evidence/completion_workspace.go completionWorkspacesOnce; use native ledger for exact paths/ranges
findings.recommendation: Define one versioned launch-binding bound/role contract, derive validators and boundary fixtures across Python/Go. Match accepted producer and completion sets without weakening file fingerprints.

findings.title: Spinner uninstall restores backup over a user change made after install
findings.evidence_level: isolated settings transformation probe + implementation read
findings.description: statusLine uninstall checks exact ownership before restoring. _uninstall_spinner_verbs restores whenever its backup key exists, even if current spinnerVerbs was changed by the user after installation.
findings.observed: Current verbs user changed after install plus prior backup becomes prior, losing the current choice.
findings.recommendation: Record exact installed spinner ownership value and restore backup only if current still equals it; otherwise preserve current custom state and remove obsolete backup metadata.

findings.title: Debug validator rejection is stateless and does not prove authorization denial
findings.description: _debughandofflib imports no filesystem/process/network facility and maintains no rejection ledger. Each CLI invocation independently validates shape/references/internal semantics. Exit2 includes correctable input failures; exit3 operational failures. Root audit should compare one-shot resubmission prose against this distinction.
findings.recommendation: Separate invalid transport/shape/reference input, unsupported causal evidence and denied authorization in the contract. Allow bounded correction of shape for the same authorized scope without silently widening authority; preserve substantive causal/regression requirements.

findings.title: Per-turn prompt owns persona delivery; SessionStart owns startup side effects
findings.description: prompt-submit composes/dedups safety and mode persona, and PreCompact changes delivery generation. SessionStart does mode housekeeping/statusline repair before activation, installs Git backstop when active, then initialized briefing and detached refresh. Documentation claiming persona injection is owned solely by SessionStart is stale.
findings.recommendation: Generate event-to-owner documentation from the implemented hook contract and retain a passive explicit-root inspection route for unfamiliar repos.

findings.title: Security review marker binds the complete staged candidate, not just sensitive lines
findings.description: The marker includes worktree identity, whole staged diff binding and sensitive diagnostics. Consumer requires all matching. Unrelated staged edits invalidate this proof. Producing the marker does not independently verify semantic reviewer PASS; the higher-level workflow owns that obligation.
findings.recommendation: Document the actual candidate boundary and generate recovery text from it; preserve complete-diff invalidation until an intentionally reviewed narrower evidence model exists.

findings.title: No startup or knowledge backstop scans stranded terminal harvest residue
findings.classification: confirmed absence within inspected entrypoint/helper scope
findings.evidence_level: complete executable-source read of relevant runtime family
findings.description: SessionStart daily standup checks Git/task/provenance/update state, and knowledge.py handles selected native knowledge edits/conversion/promotion/staleness. Neither implements a durable scan for an unharvested terminal workflow obligation. Root prose audit owns whether such an obligation is promised.
findings.recommendation: If harvest is mandatory, persist an explicit retryable per-workflow obligation and expose it in status/recovery; do not infer obligations from unrelated board prose or rerun successful external effects.

findings.title: Native client accepts optional context qualification field
findings.description: ArtifactClient._open_binary accepts either five release-manifest fields or those plus context_qualification. The farm consumer exact-five check found by host agent has a narrower acceptance set. Python method does not itself validate optional field value.
findings.recommendation: Use one versioned manifest schema for producers and consumers, retaining explicit platform/native-tested/digest checks. Host/native ledgers own candidate qualification effects.

recommendation.decision: Make each owning workflow expose a versioned transition contract and one truthful outcome projection; generate host/docs validators from shared facts and keep the existing execution/authority boundaries.
recommendation.why: The observed defects arise where valid producer/consumer sets, persisted state, delivery state and user-facing status disagree. Uniform typed decisions and replay identity improve UX recovery, DX testability and AX next-action reliability without flattening approval/CAS/lock distinctions.
